rationale: First claude attempt at torch_gated_delta_net (Mamba-2 + delta-rule linear-attention, fla.layers.GatedDeltaNet over L=20 time-axis panels) at default HPs hit 0/7 wp but avg_ann +4.3% (positive, beats torch_moirai2 #2014's -1.4% / #2015's -13.2%) with the W6 jackpot RE-REPRODUCED (thr=0.65, +104.7% ann at 36.1% WR, avg_win 10.19% vs avg_loss -3.50% = 2.91:1 reward/risk — tied/edged out tabdpt_v1 #2013's +102.1% as biggest W6 single-window ann in 20+ iters) AND W3 thr=0.0 +36.0% ann (cracking W3's -54.7% avg-ann wall on alive sweep). Threshold sweep alive on W2 (thr=0.6, 5pp shy of floor), W4 (thr=0.5, 14pp shy), W6 (thr=0.65). W1/W5/W7 collapse to thr=0.0 flood. Lever signature is fat-tail magnitude picker blocked by WR floor — same family as fastkan/tabdpt_v1/gated-delta-net W6-magnitude lever. Train mode should sweep ONE-AT-A-TIME orthogonal axes per [[fastkan-pos-weight-2-regresses]]: (a) pos_weight ∈ [1.6, 1.8] (push WR via more confident wins; do NOT exceed 1.8 per [[timesfm-pos-weight-2-regresses]]), (b) dropout ∈ [0.20, 0.30] (regularize the wild W5/W7 flood swings per [[fastkan-dropout-unlocks-w7]] single-lever pattern), (c) num_layers ∈ {1} (smaller recurrence for sharper short-window decisions), (d) lr ∈ [3e-4, 1e-3] (slower convergence on choppy sequences). Pin hidden_dim=192, num_heads=4, weight_decay=1e-4, batch_size=512, epochs=8, grad_clip=1.0. Target: lift W2/W4/W6 alive sweeps over the regime WR floor without collapsing the +104.7% W6 magnitude lever.
